description: Message a crew's Engineer while it works, e.g. "skip X", "do not touch file Y", "check Z first". The running Engineer reads it before its next step and confirms in the crew chat; one that has not started reads it on its first step, and one stopped inside the Engineer reads it when resumed. The result says which: delivery is next_step, on_start, on_resume, or next_round for a crew working outside its Engineer (an amend on its way in, review), which reads it the next time the crew is sent back to it. A crew where nothing will read it is refused with crew_not_reading_messages, whose nextStep says what to do: at an approval gate use anyforge_amend_crew; stopped outside its Engineer, resume with guidance; finished, retry. A message steers the work, it does not approve, reject or ship anything. Pass an idempotencyKey to retry safely. The body is limited to 4000 characters (max 4000 characters, not bytes), counted after trimming; a longer one is refused with body_too_long, which states the limit. Requires `approve` scope.

body.description: What the Engineer should do differently (max 4000 characters, not bytes).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 8-64 letters, digits, "_" or "-". A repeat with the same key does not send a second message.

name: anyforge_message_crew
title: Message crew
